workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits traceability and schemas before any target materialization implementation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no implementation, loss/objective construction, actor update, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if traceability requirements are incomplete
stop if tensor capture would require actor input changes

fallback_plan: admit bounded implementation only if traceability and schema are complete
pivot to source-artifact discovery audit if tensor capture sources are uncertain
pivot to broader candidate refresh if traceability is too narrow

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1622 is process audit only and cannot strengthen self-ID claims.
